lede: Exclusive student deals for ISIC cardholders on safe, all-inclusive volcano tours in East Java with Java Volcano Tour Operator.

sections.provenance_note: The badge renders this label followed by the ISIC provider ID from SITE_CONFIG.reviewLinks.isicProviderId (operational config, not content). The hero image asset stays in the page component.

sections.body_1: The International Student Identity Card (ISIC) is the only internationally recognised student identity document, endorsed by UNESCO and accepted in 130+ countries. JVTO is a registered ISIC provider — if you hold a valid ISIC card, the same private vehicle, licensed guide, and all-inclusive format as our standard packages is available at reduced per-person rates.
sections.body_2: Student pricing is confirmed via a live Alive Verify API check against the ISIC database at the time of booking. Your card must be valid and current — no card, no discount, no exceptions.
sections.provenance_note: The provider-ID value and the verify-directory URL are read from SITE_CONFIG.reviewLinks (operational config); only the labels and the provider name live here.

items.title: Enter your card number
items.body: Enter your ISIC card number when you book on the official JVTO website.

items.title: We run an Alive Verify check
items.body: JVTO runs a live Alive Verify API check against the ISIC database.

items.title: Pricing is confirmed
items.body: If the card returns valid, student pricing is confirmed for your booking.

items.title: Validity is checked on the day
items.body: Your card must be valid on the date of verification — not just the travel date. No workarounds; the check is live and automated.

sections.heading: Exclusive Student Package for ISIC Cardholders
sections.body_text: JVTO collaborates with ISIC to offer student-friendly pricing structures for safe, all-inclusive volcano tours. These prices are only available to ISIC cardholders. To redeem, you must have a valid ISIC card.
sections.provenance_note: The package cards themselves stay dynamic — getPublicPackageList (category 2) supplies names, slugs, and prices; nothing about a package is stored here.

sections.heading: What is
sections.intro_before: Opting for a student package does
sections.intro_after: mean cutting corners. It's designed for students travelling in small groups, offering a fairer pricing structure while maintaining our high standards.

items.title: Private Structure
items.body: Strictly private tour structure. No mixed groups.

items.title: All-Inclusive
items.body: Includes park fees, permits, and transport.

items.title: High Safety
items.body: Same high safety standards, including health screening.

sections.heading: Need an ISIC Card?
sections.body_text: The International Student Identity Card (ISIC) is the only globally recognized proof of full-time student status. Get yours today to unlock thousands of benefits!

sections.heading: How to Apply the ISIC Code
sections.provenance_note: Step screenshots (/assets/img/isic/isic-step-*.jpg) stay with the page component; only the step copy lives here.

items.title: Choose Your Adventure
items.body: Visit our website and select the volunteer or tour package you wish to book. Click on the "Book Now" button.

items.title: Fill in Your Details
items.body: Complete the booking form with your personal details. In the "Discount Code" field, enter your unique ISIC code.

items.title: Apply & Verify
items.body: Click "Apply". The discount will be calculated. Proceed with your booking. We may ask to verify your ISIC card upon arrival.

sections.heading: Same inclusions
sections.notice_lead: Card must be valid at verification.
sections.notice_body: Student pricing is confirmed only after a live Alive Verify check returns a valid, current card. No card, no discount — no exceptions.
